body.name: Finite-cylinder arithmetic language
body.construction: \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{closure}_{+,-,\times,/}\{P_M(C_{\mathcal A}(S,a)):S\subset V\times\mathbb Z\text{ finite},\ a\in\prod_{(i,t)\in S}\mathcal A_i\}\), where every \(P_M\) is a law on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\) and division is defined only at positive denominators.
